newsitem.title: USA: ShopKo not now in talks with big retailers.
newsitem.headline: ShopKo not now in talks with big retailers.

text.p: ShopKo Stores Inc said Friday it is not now holding talks with big retailers but is continuing to pursue expansion plans.
"At this time, there are no discussions taking place with any major retailer," President Dale Kramer said in a conference call with Wall Street analysts.
Scattered rumors about a potential transaction with Hills Stores Co circulated on Wall Street earlier this month after the collapse of ShopKo's planned $1 billion merger with Phar-Mor Inc.
Kramer said ShopKo is working with Salomon Brothers to consider alternatives "either through acquisition or other ways."
He said Shopko thinks it can prepare a growth strategy of about 15 stores per year over the next three years in markets contiguous to existing markets.
